title: Age of Empires IV
provenance: Verified locally on an Apple M2 Max with D3DMetal and MSync on 2026-11-17. Highball Play launched Steam build 26559323 using Wine from engine PR #49 (ba28330) and the shared x87sidecar based on v1.9.1. Late Siege loaded and 42 selected units followed a move order. Smaller stutters have been observed.
notes: The opt-in recipe selects D3DMetal and sets HB_AOE4=1. Requires an AoE IV-capable Wine 11 engine with the patched x87sidecar installed, Rosetta and macOS 26 or later. Wine locates the shared helper in its engine. The upstream engine manifest pin is pending.
